text: Ellery & Vane has bought the publishing rights to “The Glass Cartographer,” according to a statement from the company on Wednesday. The novel, written by Marel Finch, is set for release next spring after a competitive bidding process that drew interest from three other houses, said Liora Penn, editorial director at the Harbour City-based publisher. Penn said the deal includes North American print and digital rights and a first-look option on future works by Finch. “We believe the book will resonate strongly with readers here and abroad,” Penn said. Terms were not disclosed. Local booksellers in Southport said they expect early preorders to begin in November, with a launch event planned at the Bracken Street Library.
